_note: Antigravity tool names used in generated agent files. Source: antigravity.google/docs/subagents and /docs/hooks (checked 2026-11-20). The docs warn that a misspelled or unmapped tool name can hang a subagent: after `sat init`, open each agent once in Antigravity. If your Antigravity version names a tool differently, edit this map in the SAT repository (not in a project) and run `sat update`. Once the names are seen working in a real run in Antigravity, record it here as "confirmed": { "on": "<date>", "names": [...], "how": "<what was observed>" }; sat doctor then reports those names as confirmed instead of warning on every project.
